macros: 6 x ot_sram_1r1w_256x256_m2_r2c2 a region: 4 landing (2 a PC, code sector halves, read together = 1 key a cycle) + 2 list (gather)
instances: u_idxrg_00 .. u_idxrg_15: ONE per dsfd_ctrl_rg2 region k (= ctrl_k / rsv_k of dv_plan.rsv_links), sid strap = k = chain position

insertion.hrq_k: rsv_k.rq[681:0] -> u_idxrg_k.rqi ; u_idxrg_k.rqo -> ctrl_k.rq   (the link is split at the reader: 2 links of 682 b)
insertion.hrd_k: ctrl_k.rd[561:0] -> u_idxrg_k.rdi ; u_idxrg_k.rdo -> rsv_k.rd    (2 links of 562 b)
insertion.latency: +1 core cycle each way on the slice's HBM path (station register). Elastic HBM boundary: svc_att's credits (rk) and slot-addressed landing absorb it; no compiled svc_rs schedule depends on the HBM round trip.
insertion.static_rule: the slice's and the reader's HBM windows do not overlap on a PC (compiler); the reader issues only in cycles with no slice request and while the controller's outstanding count < DQ

chains.query: qi of region 0 = the die's IDX job frame stream (SVC FRAME PROTOCOL v1 513 b {d 512, v}: IDX_S type 4 / IDX_G type 8; other types skipped); u_idxrg_k.qo -> u_idxrg_{k+1}.qi, 2 edges a hop, neighbour-only (regions in rg2 order along the PHY N face)
chains.score: u_idxrg_0.si = 276'b0 (chain head: no upstream; the only constant input, by construction); u_idxrg_k.so -> u_idxrg_{k+1}.si; u_idxrg_15.so -> dsdv_bk_sel V ingress (BK beats, kind = strap ik of the job word = bk_sel ik strap), as an ingress-kind beat stream on the sel unit's rung (vi_s or vi_n)
chains.tail: u_idxrg_15.qo is unread (chain tail) -> port-bind waiver 'chain tail: frames are forwarded for chain uniformity, nothing downstream'
chains.reach: hops > ~405 um need forwarded half-cycle relays (die standard); the 2-edge hop budget is the schedule's unit, so a relay adds edges to BOTH chains equally (query and score) -- keep qi/qo and si/so relayed identically per hop or the per-region window alignment breaks

status: st[9:0] = {fault cause 8, busy, fault} -> the die fault tree (S81 fault fold), registered
clock_reset: ck = the region's core clock (833.333 ps, the same regional tree as ctrl_k.clk); rst = the region's reset-relay leaf (async assert, 2-flop sync release inside)

compiler.job_word: spec [19:0] B, [40:20] N (keys) / NB (blocks), [50:41] k <= 512, [80:51] KB = per-user index-key base (PC-local sector, same on every PC), [96:81] T0, [100:97] P >= 2, [103:101] ik
compiler.key_layout: position p, word j = p >> 4, lane i = p & 15: region r = i ^ h(j), h(j) = (j ^ j>>4 ^ j>>8 ^ j>>12) & 15; region stores word j at group g = j >> 4 on PC g & 1, block n = g >> 1, sector A = KB + 34 n: codes A + 2c, A + 2c + 1 (c = j & 15), scales A + 32 + (c >> 3) bytes 4 (c & 7)
compiler.window: from END (last payload word) + T0 at every region: 10 header beats, then BEAT word w at +10 + P w (2 beats); a score missing at its slot = sticky fault (fail closed). T0 / P from the bench (results/rtl/s81_idxrd_1018/README.md)
compiler.sharding: D k=3: each shard die scans its own contiguous range [B, B+N) with absolute positions (HDR base = 16 j0), so its partial top-k carries absolute indices into the existing topk_merge / topk_final path
